reference_notes: Philip's second canonical ADR-0037 example (2026-07-27). Bespoke traditional cut string staircase with decorative double-riser construction and repeating scalloped arched apron pattern. Walnut hardwood finish. Used alongside the first example (cut-string-half-open-riser-staircase.json) as the reference standard when the object is a bespoke traditional staircase. Both references define the quality bar Claude Sonnet vision must reach before we run the 981-batch.
quality_bar: Vision model must identify: (a) double-riser construction as a decorative-vs-structural distinction · (b) arched scalloped apron pattern as a specific Victorian joinery feature · (c) cut string profile · (d) walnut hardwood material · (e) high-end custom craftsmanship level. Every field of the 10-item staircase_checklist must be attempted. vision_quality_score.construction must exceed 90.
